Live From The Path
Monday, 10:00 PM to 12:00 AM
Honest Faith. Jesus. Food. Donkeys (the order is important.)
You know that neighbor of yours who wears his stocking hat old man style (above the ears, 8" of commercial retail space between the top of his bald head and the top of hat) who fires up the snow-blower at 4 a.m., always appears to be chewing gum when he really isn't, and who smells suspiciously like garlic and Aspercreme? Well, we're not him, we're just the guys talking about him. And Jesus. And how to ship a warm hot dog through the postal service. And whether the phrase "beast hot" is a pejorative, or even grammatically viable.

Stop Crying! Loving God Without Weeping.
11/15/2010
Sometimes you turn on the TV and you see all of these people being portrayed as "on fire" for Christ weeping and laughing with hands in the air and bodies convulsing around like there's a fish in their BVDs. Now, I'm in no position to say that ain't the deal. But, I don't do that. Last time I convulsed involuntarily was in reaction to the tuna spring roll from the local sushi/laundromat/bait shop.
So, am I missing out on following Christ correctly because I'm not a cryer? What does the Bible say about showing love for God? We're talking about it on this episode of Live From The Path.

Where Do I Start?
11/1/2010
Let's say you or someone you know is God curious. You feel like He might exist or you're interested in a closer relationship with Him and you don't quite know what to do from there. Well, we're here to help.
Now, let's be clear, this is a personal relationship with God we're talking about so no amount of effort on our end will make a lick of difference as to how close you are to God. Anyone of this earth that puts themselves as an intermediary between you and God is a charlatan.
That being said, as Christ followers, we can share our experiences with you, provide relevant Biblical passages about having a relationship with Christ, and be encouraging and there to answer questions.
This will be "I'm Christ Curious 101 - Where Do I Start?" and we would invite you to come along with us and pass the invitation on to anyone you know that is thinking about starting or renewing a relationship with Jesus. I'm excited about this one, folks, and look forward to seeing you there.
�
Why Do I Need To Go To Church?
10/25/2010
The church is full of hypocrites, liars, swindlers, and cheats. They only want me to come so they can take my money and control my life. Jesus is cool, though. I can follow him without having to hang around all those jokers in the church.
Do you ever feel that way? Is it possible to follow Christ without being part of a church body? We'll see what the Bible says about this, what steps you can and should take if you're in an unhealthy church situation, and how to reconcile the sometimes errant behavior of God's people within the church with how God himself sees the church.

The Man Show
9/20/2010
Where did the men go? Seriously, our culture seems to be trading out real men for flimsy, dufusy, malleable types that tread lightly, dream softly, and have ambitions of "achieving" the middle ground and doing whatever it takes not to embarass themselves.
Enough!
Our September 20th show will be focused on men. We'll be talking about the characteristics of some of the more notable Biblical men (some lessons in what not to do), where men are at in our culture, and ways to improve our impact as husbands, fathers, workers, and disciples.

Static, their first EP debut, was released July 25, 2010 and is still available for purchase. After finishing their West Coast tour in November, SOF will devote much time to the making of their first full length album, Fast Train. The expected release date is spring of 2011.
